systems.system: Project BRIDGE / Digital Value Chain Infrastructure for Boosting Employment (D-VIBE)
systems.platform: open-access fibre, extending the national backbone from about 30,000 km to about 120,000 km
systems.owner: Government of Nigeria; financed by AfDB (US$200m), World Bank (US$500m), EBRD (US$100m), an EU grant and private investment
systems.tiers: all 774 local government areas, including schools, health facilities, agro-industrial zones, rural communities and commercial hubs; local government offices not named

note: A backbone loan: the fibre is to reach all 774 local government areas, and the institutions listed as connected do not include local government offices.
